description: The DC Map policy tracker documents public actions on US data centre development: 56 actions across 25 states as of August 2026. Contents: entries filterable by state, status (48 in force, 1 pending, 1 expired, 6 defeated), type (21 moratoriums, 6 rejections, 7 ordinances, 17 legislation items, 5 executive pauses) and scale (22 statewide, 34 local), each with a date, jurisdiction, summary and permalink; Maryland has 6 actions, Arizona and Virginia 5 each, and an example entry is Pennsylvania Governor Shapiro's Executive Order 2026-05 of 18 August 2026 requiring a binding GRID commitment before state data centre permit review. Producer: DC Map, a data centre mapping and insights site. Coverage: the United States, state and local level. Access: a public interactive page with no download seen. Licence and cost: free to view; no licence stated. Caveats: a curated compilation by a commercial site, whose inclusion criteria and completeness are not audited here. Simulation uses: it documents siting and permitting constraints that affect projected data centre load growth in capacity-planning and scenario models. Related record: the data centre energy and water policy event register (data-data-centre-energy-water-policy-event-register-67).
